messages:
sara: Hey docs team — PR #4589 is blocking a customer migration. Example snippets for batching + quant profiles are out-of-date. Can someone take a look? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4589
jake: I'll pick this up. Which examples specifically?
sara: The Python SDK snippet that shows `client.optimize()` and the quant profile table. It sets `batch_size: 1` but should show `batching.window_ms: 50` and a `cache.prefix_kv` example. Also the embed/segment example references an internal link that's 404.
maria: I reproduced locally — the snippet also uses old param `quant_type: q4_0` but runtime expects `q4_1`. Quick patch suggestion below.
maria: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="...")

resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood/fast-13b-q4_1",
  input="Summarize the following...",
  optimize={"batching": {"window_ms": 50, "max_tokens": 128},
            "cache": {"prefix_kv": true}}
)
```
jake: Thanks — that looks right. CI is failing on a different example due to an extra backtick in the markdown code fence. I can push a fix.
alex: FYI docs-bot flagged a broken link: docs/optimize/examples/embedding.md -> old path. I have a suggested redirect to /optimize/batching-and-caching.md in a small patch.
docs-bot: [automated] Linkcheck: 1 broken link found in PR 4589 — file: docs/optimize/examples/embedding.md line 42.
sara: Proposed workflow: jake update the snippet and fix fences, maria update quant profile and note migration guidance (q4_0 -> q4_1), alex run linkcheck and add redirect. ETA EOD today? If so I'll tag release notes and coordinate with support.
jake: on it, pushing a fix to branch `docs/4589-fix-snippets` now.
maria: pushed my patch and added a short note in migration.md about numeric stability and perf tradeoffs between `q4_0` and `q4_1`.
alex: ran linkcheck locally after redirect, all green. CI still failed on one example for `kv_cache` formatting (markdown table misaligned) — will do small grammar/tables tweak.
jake: CI green after fixes, tests passing. Merging in ~10m. @sara can you verify sample output formatting and that the snippet runs with the SDK pinned to latest?
sara: Verified on staging with the latest SDK — sample output matches expectation and the batching example shows reduced token count per request. :tada: Go ahead and merge.
sara: Thanks everyone — I'll add a short note to the release changelog about the quant-profile rename and the cache example update.
alex: Added a follow-upissue in the repo to audit any other pages referencing `q4_0`. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/109.
maria: Nice. If customers ask, we can point them to the migration snippet in /optimize/migration-guide.md.
